title: The Case Study of Vanitas
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a steampunk, 19th-century Paris, the kind vampire Noé Archiviste meets Vanitas, a brash human who claims to be a 'vampire doctor'. Using a grimoire tied to the legendary Vampire of the Blue Moon, Vanitas restores vampires afflicted by a curse that corrupts their true names and drives them to prey on humans. The pair investigate the mysterious Charlatan behind the curse while human-vampire tensions and Vanitas's hidden past surface.
life_message: It holds up recovering one's true identity and choosing whom to save, even when one's own motives are tangled.
